title: spec.skill.md Phase 11 create_branch forks from current HEAD, not main
description: Phase 11 calls create_branch after the spec commit. If the session started on a non-main branch (e.g. a fix_signal feature branch), the new spec implementation branch is forked from that branch rather than from main. This creates a branch with mixed ancestry spanning both the fix_signal work and the new spec, complicating future merges and making the spec branch's base ambiguous.
proposed_resolution: Update spec.skill.md Phase 11 to ensure create_branch always forks from main. Either: (a) extend the create_branch tool to accept a base_branch parameter (defaulting to main) and update the spec skill to pass base_branch: 'main'; or (b) add an explicit checkout of main before calling create_branch using a moeb VCS tool. The tool should verify the resulting branch points to the spec commit, not to an unrelated feature branch.
